occurrences.text: And she said, Who would have said unto Abraham, that Sarah should have given children suck? for I have born him a son in his old age.
How long wilt thou speak these things? and how long shall the words of thy mouth be like a strong wind?
My words shall be of the uprightness of my heart: and my lips shall utter knowledge clearly.
Who can utter the mighty acts of the Lord? who can shew forth all his praise?
He winketh with his eyes, he speaketh with his feet, he teacheth with his fingers;

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
